battle-focus.txt: Spend Battle Focus tokens for Agile Manoeuvres: extra move, longer pile-ins, Fade Back and similar repositioning.

relentless.txt: While you control an objective, an enemy unit that ends a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move on it takes D3 mortal wounds on a 2+. Triggered by enemy movement, not by your attacks, so it sits outside the matrix.

void-thieves.txt: Anhrathe units keep an objective under your control after they leave it, until the opponent’s level of control is higher at the end of a phase.

veterans.txt: Each Anhrathe unit may take one unique Corsair Enhancement for points.

far-reaching.txt: When Rangers or Shroud Runners shoot, enemy units have +6" detection range until they have shot.

archraider.txt: Lord of Deceit (Aura): once per turn, an enemy Stratagem used on a unit within 12" costs 1CP more.

voidstone.txt: Models in the unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

assassins-eye.txt: Ranged attacks that target a Character unit get +1 AP. None of the 19 benchmark targets is a Character, so it sits idle until you switch on “Target is a Character unit”. With that on, every target is treated as a unit with a Character in it.

camo-snipers.txt: This unit’s ranged attacks don’t stop it from being hidden.

burning-lance.txt: While leading, Melta weapons in the unit get +6" range. That makes the “within half range” switch realistic for the Dragons; it doesn’t change the dice.

unquenchable.txt: The first time Fuegan is destroyed, he stands back up with full wounds on a 2+.

fury-void.txt: After Kharseth’s unit shoots, an enemy unit hit by Dread of the Deep Void is riven: every Aeldari attack against it gets +1 Strength until end of turn.
fury-void.markTxt: Fury of the Void: +1 Strength for every attack.

aethersense.txt: Enemy units arriving from Reserves can’t be set up within 12" of Kharseth.

whispering-web.txt: After Lhykhis shoots, an enemy unit she hit is webbed: Aeldari attacks against it score critical hits on unmodified 5+.

empyric-ambush.txt: While leading, the Warp Spiders can charge after using Flickerjump.

piratical-hero.txt: While Yriel leads a unit, every attack made by a model in it (Yriel included) has Sustained Hits 1 and adds 1 to the hit roll. On a 2+ weapon the +1 changes nothing, because an unmodified 1 always misses; the Sustained Hits still adds an extra hit on every 6.

prince-corsairs.txt: After deployment, redeploy up to three Aeldari units, into Strategic Reserves if you like.

assured.txt: In the Shooting phase, ranged attacks against Monster or Vehicle units can re-roll the hit, the wound and the damage roll. Fuegan benefits while he leads them.

reavers.txt: Re-roll hit rolls of 1; re-roll any hit roll if the target is within range of an objective (switch “Target is on an objective”). Kharseth benefits while he leads them.

raiders.txt: Pick one enemy unit at the start of the battle. Weapons in this unit have Lethal Hits and Precision against it. Yriel benefits while he leads them.
raiders.markTxt: Piratical Raiders: Lethal Hits for the unit and its leader.

flickerjump.txt: Normal move becomes 24", no charge that turn, mortal wound on each 1 rolled per model.

guide.txt: End of your Movement phase: pick an enemy unit within 18". Every Aeldari attack against it gets +1 to hit.
guide.markTxt: Guide: +1 to hit for every attack.

branching.txt: While leading, once per phase turn one hit, wound or damage roll into a 6. Your Farseer isn’t leading anything here, so it’s idle.

spirit-mark.txt: Pick a Wraith Construct unit within 6" and an enemy unit: that Wraith unit gets Sustained Hits 1 against it.
spirit-mark.markTxt: Spirit Mark: Sustained Hits 1 for the Wraith Constructs.

spirit-marked.txt: When the Spiritseer marks the target, the Wraithblades get Sustained Hits 1 against it.

tears-isha.txt: Command phase: a nearby Wraith Construct unit returns a model or heals D3.

spiritseer-lo.txt: Lone Operative while within 3" of a Wraith Construct unit.

psyguide.txt: Within 12" of a friendly Aeldari Psyker: Leadership 6+ and +1 to hit. On by default since the Farseer and Spiritseer run with them.

malevolent.txt: A Wraithblade killed in melee before it fights gets to fight anyway on a 3+.

target-acq.txt: After shooting, an enemy unit hit by the long rifles loses the benefit of cover for the rest of the phase. In practice: switch “Target has cover” off for anyone shooting after them.

path-outcast.txt: When an enemy ends a move within 8", the Rangers can make a D6" Normal move.

raid-run.txt: End of the Fight phase: move or fall back D3+3".

serpent-shield.txt: Ranged attacks with Strength higher than its Toughness get −1 to wound.

hallucinogen.txt: Start of the opponent’s Shooting phase: give an Aeldari Infantry unit within 36" Stealth.

mistshield.txt: The Felarch has a 4+ invulnerable save.

channeller.txt: Once per turn the first failed save in the unit has its damage set to 0.

faolchu.txt: Ranged weapons in the bearer’s unit have Ignores Cover. Only matters when “Target has cover” is on.

shrine-token.txt: Once per battle, turn one hit or wound roll by a non-Character model into an unmodified 6. Too small and one-off to price into an average.

combat-doctrines.txt: Once per battle each, switch the army (or a unit) into a doctrine: Assault lets units advance and still charge, Devastator gives ranged attacks Assault, Tactical lets units fall back and still shoot or charge. All movement, so the matrix leaves it out.

full-throttle.txt: After charging, Thunder Hammers get +1 to hit and Sustained Hits 1, and every other melee weapon gets +1 Damage and Sustained Hits 1. The whole attached unit benefits.

shattered-defences.txt: After the Thunderstrike shoots, a Monster or Vehicle it hit is marked: friendly Adeptus Astartes ranged attacks against it get +1 AP.
shattered-defences.markTxt: Shattered Defences: +1 AP for ranged attacks against a marked Monster or Vehicle.

thunderstrike.txt: Ranged attacks against Monster or Vehicle units get +1 to wound.

damaged.txt: While at or below the listed wounds, the model’s attacks get −1 to hit. The matrix assumes it’s healthy; set −1 Hit for it in the modifier bar if it isn’t.

bladeguard.txt: Once per turn in the Fight phase, pick +1 to hit for the unit’s melee attacks, or −1 to be hit. The matrix assumes you take the attack bonus.

furious-assault.txt: Melee attacks gain Sustained Hits 1 against anything that isn’t a Monster or Vehicle.

spear-chogoris.txt: Ranged attacks gain Assault, and advancing doesn’t stop the unit charging. Movement only.

trophy-taker.txt: Against Character units, re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1. The whole attached unit benefits.

for-the-khan.txt: Ranged attacks gain Assault and melee attacks gain Lance, so the unit gets +1 to wound on the charge.

tactical-precision.txt: The unit’s attacks gain Lethal Hits against anything that isn’t a Monster or Vehicle.

hunters-eye.txt: The unit’s ranged attacks gain Ignores Cover and Sustained Hits 1.

deeds-of-legend.condNm: Your unit is on an objective
deeds-of-legend.txt: While the unit is within range of an objective, its melee attacks get +1 Attack.

imperiums-sword.txt: Gives the bearer an extra weapon. Its profile comes in with the roster file, so it’s already in the loadout.

litany-of-hate.txt: Melee attacks gain Lance, so the unit gets +1 to wound on the charge.

catechism-of-fire.txt: When the unit shoots, pick a visible enemy: ranged attacks against it gain Devastating Wounds. The matrix assumes you pick the unit you’re shooting.

spearpoint-paragon.txt: The bearer’s own melee attacks get +1 Strength and +1 AP, or +2 of each if it charged this turn.

hailstrike.txt: After the Hailstrike shoots, a unit it hit is marked: friendly Adeptus Astartes ranged attacks against it ignore cover.
hailstrike.markTxt: Hailstrike: ranged attacks against it ignore cover.

into-the-fray.txt: After charging, melee attacks gain Cleave 1: +1 attack for every five models in the target unit.

spearpoint-tf.txt: Detachment rule: select the Assault or Tactical Doctrine one extra time per battle; friendly Mounted and Speeder units get +1 to Advance rolls; Suboden Khan’s unit gains Wrath of the First Khan. White Scars only. Movement only, so the matrix leaves it out.

assault-brethren.txt: Detachment rule: select the Assault Doctrine one extra time per battle. With Spearpoint Task Force as well, you have enough doctrine uses to keep one active every battle round.

wrath-first-khan.txt: From Spearpoint Task Force. At the end of the Fight phase, if Suboden’s unit was eligible to fight, it can make a Normal move if unengaged or Fall Back if engaged. That frees it to charge again next turn, which is when its charge bonuses (Full-throttle Assault, Lance) apply.

targeted-intercession.txt: After charging, melee attacks get +1 Strength and +1 AP.

meta.name: The Burning One and the Exile
meta.sub: Aeldari, Path of the Outcast and Corsair Coterie, Priority Assets. Built in from your Oct 2 roster and text export.

imp-scouts-7.txt: This ability always takes the form Scouts X". In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can do one of the following: If that unit is in strategic reserves, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone.If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a scout move (24.32).If that unit is embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts ability, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT can make a scout move.

imp-deep-strike.txt: Each time this unit makes an ingress move (20.04), if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone.

imp-deadly-demise-d3.txt: This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X. Each time a model with this ability is destroyed, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their emergency disembark moves, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a deadly demise; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by X (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").

imp-deadly-demise-1.txt: This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X. Each time a model with this ability is destroyed, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their emergency disembark moves, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a deadly demise; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by X (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").

imp-stealth.txt: If every model in a unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, that unit has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).

imp-scouts-9.txt: This ability always takes the form Scouts X". In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can do one of the following: If that unit is in strategic reserves, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone.If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a scout move (24.32).If that unit is embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts ability, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT can make a scout move.

imp-infiltrators.txt: During deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from your opponent’s deployment zone and all enemy units.
